mvp_scope: valid small game, winning team heroes only
pom_scope: completed BO, winning team heroes, mean of all played valid maps including losses
features: Public events and terminal hero counters; rates per 100 effective rounds (mapTurns + finalBattleActions/10).
damage: Hero damage capped by remaining HP; no overkill credit. Final-hit events already contain effective damage.
healing: Effective healing to allies only; self healing shown separately, not scored.
assists: Derived, not engine-native: damage/control on victim or healing of the killer in preceding 3 map turns / 30 final actions; unique per kill, excluding killer.
structures: Effective push damage split equally among recorded contributors, divided by target maximum HP. Individual damage is an attribution convention, not a separately recorded engine fact.
ancients: Successful objective credit split among winning-team contributors during that spawn cycle, using engine jungle weight 2, others 1.
camps: Successful camp credit shared by recorded recipients.
normalization: Primitive positive features use frozen same-role empirical midrank percentiles, zero credit for zero positive contribution. Composite role score is again converted to its frozen same-role empirical percentile, removing differences among role weight distributions.
eligibility: Actual damage to heroes, healing allies, successful control, objective contribution or a kill; income alone is insufficient.
ties: Full precision; MVP then lower same-role death percentile, otherwise joint award. POM then map-MVP count, then lower mean same-role death percentile, otherwise joint award.
invalid_or_draw: Technical-invalid games and draws do not receive MVP; incomplete or technically-held BO does not receive POM.
result_independence: Awards do not alter game, BO, standings, seeds or qualification.
limitations: Attribution is a public-event convention, not counterfactual causal proof or a general measure of model quality.
